document: Gate 3-B.2 task 6: condition-gold new vs old changelog for the 10 frozen issues.
expectation_rationale: The frozen G3-A.1 condition gold already took freshness from the build-time restage guarantee (fresh=true) and already contained the T2A institutional branch. The G3-B construct defects were in the LIVE freshness endpoint (absent record.run_tree compared to the attestation) and in the T2A PROMPT (trust grant never communicated), not in the gold rule or these gold values. The repair aligns endpoint + prompt with the gold; it must not edit gold to flatter a model.
fact_source_changes: applicability freshness is explicitly sourced from the independent git-restage write-tree vs signed attestation (g3a_freshness_recompute.json), surfaced three-state (TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN); missing record.run_tree can no longer be read as stale.
trust_expression_changes: T2A prompt/block now explicitly state the institutional L/F/C warranty the T2A gold branch assumed; ACCEPT/REJECT is never revealed.
gold_tier: PROVISIONAL (n=1; annotator2 NOT_OBTAINED); protocol repair does not raise authority
